description: Mirrors the channels you map to a Discord server you choose, with members' names, avatars and messages, and shows Discord users' messages here. Members can opt out per channel. Switching it off removes the webhooks from Discord and the mappings here. Only the server owner can switch it on or off.
name: Discord bridge

description: Save messages privately, with a note, and find them again in the bookmarks panel.
name: Bookmarks

description: Save poll setups for the server and start a new poll from one with a click.
name: Poll templates

description: Remind me about a message or a note with /remind or the message menu; the reminder arrives as a direct message.
name: Reminders

description: Compose a message now and send it later. Members see and cancel their own from the composer's clock button.
name: Scheduled messages

description: Members who share their birthday are announced in a channel on the day, and can get a role for 24 hours.
name: Birthdays

description: Members earn XP for chatting (with a cooldown) and rise through levels. Opt-in per server, and members can opt out.
name: Leveling

description: Post new chapters and episodes from the Library and Cinema into a channel as cards.
name: Library feed

description: Post new entries of RSS and Atom feeds into a channel. Feeds are fetched by the server with SSRF protection.
name: RSS and Atom feeds

description: Members post suggestions to a channel, everyone votes with reactions, and staff mark them approved, denied or implemented.
name: Suggestions

description: Members open a private thread with the staff role to ask for help, and staff close it when it is done.
name: Ticket threads

description: Announce in a channel when a watch party starts in the server, with an optional role ping.
name: Watch party announcer

description: Post a live card in the channel when a party starts
name: Watch party cards

description: Categories that are not offered in the server directory.
name: Hidden directory categories

description: Start a thread on every message posted in chosen channels.
name: Auto-thread

description: Joining a hub voice channel makes a private room for the member and removes it when it empties.
name: Join to create

description: A shared queue in voice channels, with vote-skip, a DJ and synced playback from members' own storage. Off, the jukebox routes are refused and the strip disappears from voice channels.
name: Voice jukebox

description: A voice channel that plays a playlist around the clock for whoever is in it. Off, the room routes are refused and no room advances. It also stops while the jukebox is off.
name: Listening rooms

description: Show a preview of the message behind a message link, when everyone here could already read it.
name: Message link quotes

description: Members pick roles by reacting to a message.
name: Reaction roles

description: A photo, short clip, line of text or track on your avatar for 24 hours, shown to mutual friends or the servers you choose. Rings are deleted for good when the day is over.
name: Status rings

description: A vault of messages worth keeping. Reactions, or a member with the right role, copy a message and its files into this server's own storage, where the server can browse them as a gallery.
name: Scrapbook

description: Raise slowmode in chosen channels during recurring time windows and restore it afterwards.
name: Slowmode schedules

description: Repost messages that collect enough of one reaction into a showcase channel, with a live count.
name: Starboard

description: Show the member count in the name of a channel.
name: Stat channels

description: Keep a message at the bottom of a channel by re-posting it as the conversation moves on.
name: Sticky messages

description: Greet new members and note departures in a channel, with an optional welcome DM.
name: Welcome and goodbye

description: Give new members roles when they join, optionally after a delay or once they accept the rules.
name: Auto-roles

description: Record joins, leaves, bans, edits, deletes and role changes in a log channel.
name: Mod log

description: Members can report messages, people, channels, servers, library items and cinema titles. Reports go to the server's moderators or to platform staff (D-209). The setting is platform-wide, not per server (D-329).
name: Reports

description: Grant a role for a limited time; it is removed automatically.
name: Temporary roles

description: Lets activities in voice channels share state and input through the call's data channel, sealed with the call's keys. Off, new data channels are refused by the voice server and activities start without the capability.
name: Activity data channel

description: The theme each section starts with for a member who has not chosen one.
name: Default themes

description: The operator's switch for the Discord bridge. Turning it off hides the module in every server, refuses every bridge route and removes every server's bridge from Discord (the webhooks it created) and from here; a server must switch it on again, paste its token and map its channels afresh.
name: Discord bridge

description: Members and servers connect their own S3-compatible buckets. Turning it off hides every storage screen and refuses every mount route; the instance bucket keeps serving the media already on it.
name: Bring your own storage

description: Minimum registration age, copyright strike review, data-request deadline and the operator country and contact.
name: Compliance

description: Plays the ROMs members keep in their own storage in the browser, alone or together. Off, the games page is hidden and the ROM list and the emulator cores are refused.
name: Emulator

description: Only shows a page. Game servers are not built yet: while this is on, Server Settings has a Game Servers entry and the voice Activities picker has a tile, both marked "Coming soon", and nothing behind them works. Turn it off to hide both; the page address then answers not found.
name: Game servers page

description: Link preview hosts and rate, GIF region and locale, and which lookup providers are offered. Secrets and endpoints stay in the operator config.
name: Integrations policy

description: Lets members choose to show parts of their profile to people without an account, at /~handle. Off (the default), every profile stays inside the instance and the public address answers 404 for everyone. It also needs the setting profiles.access to be opt_in_public (default walled). Public pages are never indexed by search engines.
name: Public profiles
